extensionDescription.message: Remove unwanted classes from your TPU timetable. Hide one class or set a recurring rule.

confirmHelp.message: This hides classes with the same subject, instructor, and class type across all weeks for this group.

fullStatus.message: All classes are visible. Marked classes are hidden in your filtered timetable.

filteredStatus.message: Rules are saved in this browser. To restore a class, switch to the full timetable.

backgroundUnavailable.message: The extension’s background process is unavailable.

readFailed.message: Could not load rules. $VALUE$ Reload the page to try again.

groupPageOnly.message: This action is available only on a TPU group timetable.

invalidLesson.message: Invalid class details. Reload the page.

missingDateTime.message: Could not determine the class date and time.

unsupportedRules.message: The saved rules use an unsupported format. No changes were saved.

invalidExceptions.message: The saved exceptions are invalid. No changes were saved.

groupMismatch.message: The class belongs to a different group.
